title: Choose the visual world for BukSU Market
question: Fresh hand. The roll assigned Campus ID Card. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll. Navy + green stays fixed in every option.

options.label: Campus ID Card
options.lineage: The student ID every BukSUan wears on a lanyard: photo left, labeled fields, a number strip
options.thesis: Every listing is issued like a campus ID: photo, labeled fields, a number. It belongs here, so you can trust it.
options.viewport: Search and filters sit in a navy header band like the ID's top strip; below, listings are ID-proportioned cards: photo, then SIZE / SCHOOL / CONDITION as labeled fields, and the price printed large as the card's number.
options.risk: Could read as official if it borrows real university marks; it won't use any seal, crest or official naming.

raised.raise: Every fact sits in a labeled segment with tabular figures, so cards scan like documents, not ads.
Each listing prints a short No. (e.g. No. 5DCEAB) that buyers can quote on Messenger.
State is palette law: green means available or act, gray means sold, never decorative.
The price is the hull number: the one oversized numeral on every card.

options.label: Bulletin Board Notice
options.lineage: The campus corkboard where students pinned FOR SALE notes with tear-off contact tabs
options.thesis: Every listing is a pinned notice; the tear-off tab is the Message Seller button.
options.viewport: A board of slightly overlapping notices sorted into columns by category; each notice's tear-off strip is the contact action.
options.risk: Familiar corkboard nostalgia that many campus apps reach for, and overlap costs density on phones.

options.label: Boarding Pass + Gate Board
options.lineage: Airline boarding passes and departure boards
options.thesis: Listings as segmented passes on a board ranked by what's newest or cheapest.
options.viewport: A live board of listing rows, each opening into a pass with labeled segments.
options.case: Clear and dense for scanning, but few students fly, so it identifies less than an ID card.
options.risk: Row-based board undersells the photos that sell the item.

options.label: Teletext Service
options.thesis: Three-digit pages of block mosaic on black.
options.case: Breaks the light palette and students have never seen teletext.
options.kept: Every listing gets a short quotable number.

options.label: CRT Arcade
options.case: Hides real photos behind pixel style; no task fit.

options.label: Racing League Livery
options.thesis: Liveried crafts racing left to right.
options.viewport: A grid of liveried listing crafts.
options.case: High energy, nothing to do with a campus market.
options.risk: Loud where the task needs calm.

options.label: Cyclorama Dawn
options.thesis: Light bands from night to day.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A Carousell / Facebook Marketplace-style clean card grid, executed with full craft.
canonCard.viewport: Search bar, category chips and a rounded photo-card grid, exactly as students expect.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from every other marketplace by design.
